name: @aura/capability-fabric
description: AURA Capability Fabric — the single governed path by which anything in AURA Hub causes a side effect. One capability namespace spans AURA's own subsystems and external execution nodes; every invocation passes risk classification, a configurable policy decision, an approval gate where required, a bounded executor, verification, and an audit record. The Fabric sits UNDER Mission Control v3 and the Workflow Engine — it owns no missions, no task graph and no scheduling.
